polls.description: Chinese AI startup DeepSeek is raising record funding and launching products that directly challenge Western AI leaders, while geopolitical tensions affect China-related AI deals.
polls.question: Should Western companies use Chinese AI models despite security concerns?

cluster_stories.title: Hundreds of Mundane AI Apps Are Hiding Sexually Abusive Deepfake Features
cluster_stories.summary: WIRED uncovered some 400 apps and websites linked to Chinese-language developers that look like regular AI tools but had secret features that let users create violent AI-generated images and video.
cluster_stories.headline: 400 AI APPS HIDING DEEPFAKE ABUSE FEATURES... Linked to China

cluster_stories.title: Oracle abandons $7 billion Tencent AI deal under Trump pressure: FT
cluster_stories.summary: US officials approached Oracle to raise concerns about the Tencent deal, the newspaper said, citing people familiar with the matter.
cluster_stories.headline: ORACLE KILLS $7B Tencent AI Deal Under Trump Pressure

cluster_stories.title: China’s Largest Startup Deal Ever Lifts Global Venture Funding To $59B In October
cluster_stories.summary: Global venture funding in October totaled $59 billion, a 45% jump from a year earlier, per Crunchbase data, in large part due to a record-setting $15.9 billion funding round for China’s DeepSeek.
cluster_stories.headline: DEEPSEEK RAISES $15.9B... LARGEST STARTUP DEAL EVER

cluster_stories.title: DeepSeek Drops Enhanced Coding Agent With Aim to Rival Anthropic
cluster_stories.summary: DeepSeek has released a prototype of a more autonomous coding agent as it seeks to challenge Anthropic PBC’s popular Claude Code.
cluster_stories.headline: DeepSeek Launches Coding Agent to Challenge Anthropic Claude

cluster_stories.title: Startups recalibrate Chinese AI for the West
cluster_stories.summary: A growing number of startups are editing powerful Chinese open-weight models for Western businesses that are concerned about censorship and security.
cluster_stories.headline: Western Startups Strip Censorship From Chinese AI Models

polls.description: Anthropic is advancing toward a major IPO while warning about approaching AGI thresholds and facing financial pressures from high compute costs.
polls.question: Should Anthropic go public now despite worsening margins and AGI warnings?

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
cluster_stories.summary: RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC WARNS: SELF-BUILDING AI 'VERY CLOSE'... RSI Threshold Near

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic Taps Macquarie, CommSec for Australia IPO Retail Offer
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic PBC has tapped eight firms including Macquarie Group Ltd. and Commonwealth Bank of Australia’s CommSec unit for its Australian retail offer ahead of its highly anticipated Nasdaq debut that’s set to be among the largest ever initial public offerings.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC TAPS AUSSIE BANKS FOR IPO RETAIL OFFER... Nasdaq Debut Imminent

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic is working on a system to prove AI models’ identity
cluster_stories.summary: Called FlashProve, the system would let anyone check that an AI response really came from the model it claims to be from.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC LAUNCHES FlashProve: AI Model Identity Verification System

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic is still grappling with the economics of compute
cluster_stories.summary: At a moment when Anthropic's compute margins should be getting better, they’re getting worse.
cluster_stories.headline: Anthropic's Compute Margins WORSENING Despite Scale

cluster_stories.title: Dario Amodei wants ‘a country of geniuses in a data center.’ Realizing that vision requires risky financial mechanics, Anthropic’s IPO filing shows
cluster_stories.summary: The company has used convertible notes and a complex financing deal with Broadcom to backstop its AI infrastructure buildout. But analysts question whether it will be able to continue to tap funding at competitive interest rates.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC IPO REVEALS RISKY FINANCING... Broadcom Deal Questioned
